# Larkspur Labs Staff Handbook

Larkspur Labs is a fictional company. This handbook was written for Neuron's knowledge evaluation corpus and contains no real policies or personal data.

## Working Hours

Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00 in the employee's local time zone. Outside core hours, staff choose their own schedule.

## On-Call Rota

| Team | Primary on-call window | Escalation contact |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Platform | Monday to Thursday, 08:00–20:00 UTC | Platform lead |
| Data | Friday to Sunday, 08:00–20:00 UTC | Data lead |
| Support | Every day, 20:00–08:00 UTC | Duty manager |

## Travel Expenses

| Expense | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| Hotel, per night, domestic | 180 EUR |
| Hotel, per night, international | 240 EUR |
| Meals, per day | 55 EUR |
| Rail travel | Second class, unless the journey is longer than four hours |

Receipts must be submitted within 30 days of the trip.

## Equipment

Every new employee receives a laptop, which is replaced every three years. Lost equipment must be reported to the IT desk within 24 hours.
